host.ask: IP address or host name of the chamber's MB2 controller (Ethernet port)
host.help: Shown on the MB2 touchscreen under Settings / Ethernet (DHCP or the fixed address your IT gave it). Port 502 is assumed; put `port` in config.json if BINDER's document says otherwise.

unit.help: 1 unless the controller's Modbus address was changed in its settings.
